queue.name: Opening, moves 9-12 (mostly Black Sicilian and vs London/Zukertort)
queue.check: Moves 9-12: before each move, ask what the opponent's last move changed and whether your king and loose pieces are safe. Review your last 10 games in your weakest lines.

queue.name: Allowing forks
queue.check: Before each move: which squares can his knights, queen and pawns reach, and do any of them hit two of my pieces?

queue.name: Hanging pieces
queue.check: Blunder check before you release the piece: after this move, which of my pieces are undefended or attacked more times than defended?

queue.name: Mating attacks against you
queue.check: Every move: checks, captures, threats against my king. Count the defenders around the king before opening it up.
